title: The Scientists Who Starved Guarding a Room Full of Seeds
notes: Register: utterly plain. speaking_rate 0.90, the slowest in the run. No music under any part of it. This is the heaviest video and it needs room.

This video is the deliberate exception to the cartoon cast: there is NO cast. No generated image depicts the scientists, Vavilov, or a starving person. Every generated frame is an object, a seed, a map or an empty room. Vavilov appears only in his real photograph (p03).

Motion comes from the explainer layer: Vavilov's routes drawing across the world map, seed pins dropping, counters, the seed trays filling, names and dates set as type. Energy is high only for Vavilov's life's work (s07-s12); calm for the siege; still for each death.
The key archival image is p09: vegetable plots dug on St Isaac's Square in 1942 (then Vorovsky Square), the square the institute stands on.
All modern photographs of the institute carry the caption 'The institute today'. Without it they would read as wartime.
No siege photograph showing bodies or the dying is used, and none should be added. Commons has many.
The siege map (p07) is a PNG rendering of an SVG reference map; its own labels are allowed.
The vault and the barred window are generic. The Saratov prison and the Svalbard vault are never depicted; Svalbard is a dot on the world map.
Pronunciation notes for Chirp are at the top of narration.md.
Every archival URL was resolved from the Commons API.
Guide object: the empty desk with a seed packet (s01, s05, s29, s56).
